<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Commander''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍少佐</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置の他の帝国軍（リーダーは除く）は全員、没収値＋1。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Imperial-Commander-PSA-157709592.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">典型的な帝国軍のリーダー。日々、訓練と緊急事態の演習を重ね、部隊の能力を高いレベルに保つ。デイン・ジャー少佐は、その勇気と実行力で知られている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Major.

'''Card text:'''
Each of your other Imperials at the same location (except leaders) is forfeit +1.

'''Lore:'''
A typical Imperial leader. Daily training and crisis drills keep the unit's ability high. Major Daine Jir is known for courage and follow-through.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 帝国軍少佐.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Commander]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
